title: The Ungrateful Guest
author: James Baldwin
summary: 腓力国王的士兵忘恩负义、夺走救命恩人的农场，最终被烙上耻辱标记。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1896 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: Among the soldiers of King Philip there was a poor man who had done some brave deeds. He had pleased the king in more ways than one, and so the king put a good deal of trust in him.
paragraphs.zh: 腓力国王的士兵中有一个穷人，曾立下一些勇敢的功劳。他在许多方面都让国王满意，因此国王很信任他。

paragraphs.en: One day this soldier was on board of a ship at sea when a great storm came up. The winds drove the ship upon the rocks, and it was wrecked. The soldier was cast half-drowned upon the shore; and he would have died there, had it not been for the kind care of a farmer who lived close by.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，这名士兵乘船出海，遇上了大风暴。狂风把船吹到礁石上，船撞毁了。士兵半死不活地被冲上岸；要不是附近一位农夫好心照料，他就会死在那里。

paragraphs.en: When the soldier was well enough to go home, he thanked the farmer for what he had done, and promised that he would repay him for his kindness.
paragraphs.zh: 士兵身体恢复到可以回家时，感谢了农夫的照顾，并许诺一定会报答他的恩情。

paragraphs.en: But he did not mean to keep his promise. He did not tell King Philip about the man who had saved his life. He only said that there was a fine farm by the seashore, and that he would like very much to have it for his own. Would the king give it to him?
paragraphs.zh: 但他并不打算信守诺言。他没有向腓力国王提起那个救过他命的人，只说海边有一座很好的农场，他很想据为己有。国王肯把它赐给他吗？

paragraphs.en: "Who owns the farm now?" asked Philip.
paragraphs.zh: “那座农场现在是谁的？”腓力问。

paragraphs.en: "Only a churlish farmer, who has never done anything for his country," said the soldier.
paragraphs.zh: “只是一个粗鲁吝啬的农夫，从来没为国家做过任何事。”士兵说。

paragraphs.en: "Very well, then," said Philip. "You have served me for a long time, and you shall have your wish. Go and take the farm for yourself."
paragraphs.zh: “那好吧，”腓力说，“你为我效力很久了，我会满足你的愿望。去把农场拿走吧，归你了。”

paragraphs.en: And so the soldier made haste to drive the farmer from his house and home. He took the farm for his own.
paragraphs.zh: 于是士兵急忙把农夫从家里赶走，把农场占为己有。

paragraphs.en: The poor farmer was stung to the heart by such treatment. He went boldly to the king, and told the whole story from beginning to end. King Philip was very angry when he learned that the man whom he had trusted had done so base a deed. He sent for the soldier in great haste; and when he had come, he caused these words to be burned in his forehead:
paragraphs.zh: 可怜的农夫受到这样的对待，心如刀割。他鼓起勇气去见国王，把事情的来龙去脉原原本本讲了一遍。腓力国王得知自己信任的人做出如此卑劣的事，非常愤怒。他急忙召来那名士兵，等士兵到了，便命人在他额头上烙下这几个字：

paragraphs.en: Thus all the world was made to know of the mean act by which the soldier had tried to enrich himself; and from that day until he died all men shunned and hated him.
paragraphs.zh: 这样一来，所有人都知道了这名士兵为发财而做出的卑鄙行径；从那天起直到他死，人们都躲着他、憎恨他。
